- "The branch under review is spike/consolidate." — very low relevance score (0.07), reads like leftover session state rather than a durable project fact.

Both of these look like they were captured mid-task and never cleaned up — good candidates to drop entirely during handoff rather than carry forward.

Everything else (CI pipeline steps, crate layout, auth via `ATLAS_TOKEN`, branch naming, PR/merge policy, logging format, docs tooling, etc.) reads as consistent and non-duplicated.
